mapper.insert: insert into role_assignment_rule (id, role_id, organization_id, department_id, position_id, enabled, sync_mode, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{roleId}, #{organizationId}, #{departmentId}, #{positionId}, #{enabled}, #{syncMode}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, role_id, organization_id, department_id, position_id, enabled, sync_mode, create_time, update_time from role_assignment_rule where role_id = #{roleId} order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into workflow_definition (id, code, name, scene, scope_type, scope_id, default_flow, enabled, description, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{scene}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{defaultFlow}, #{enabled}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into workflow_role (id, flow_id, code, name, role_type, role_id, field_key, enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{flowId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{roleType}, #{roleId}, #{fieldKey}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, flow_id, code, name, role_type, role_id, field_key, enabled, create_time, update_time from workflow_role where flow_id = #{flowId} order by create_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into status_flow_role_permission (id, flow_id, status_flow_id, workflow_role_id, visible, operable, enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{flowId}, #{statusFlowId}, #{workflowRoleId}, #{visible}, #{operable}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
